title: pm-dispatch: a governed PR at ACCEPT gets `needs-user-decision` and a Chinese 「维护者速读」 brief (what / why / risk / recommendation / the one act asked), so the maintainer can tell from the list what awaits him and confirm quickly
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) on the maintainer's instruction, 2026-09-05T13:1xZ, verbatim: 「我看到有很多5小时之前积压的pr,单我从列表看不出来哪些是需要我审核的,对于需要我审核的任务,比如adr,应该由契约复审先帮我审核,用中文从业务角度写上分析和意见,然后我就可以快速确认。」 Self-triaged `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`, governed (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` + `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`).

## The gap

A governed PR (ADR, agent constitution, PM protocol, hooks) reaches its terminal when the seat posts ACCEPT and requests the human approvers; from the PR list nothing distinguishes it from any other open PR, and the ACCEPT is an English engineering record, not a decision brief. Today five such PRs sat between 5 and 10 hours at that terminal. Decision cards (`needs-user-decision`) have the list-view signal but their four-facet analysis is written for the seat, not for a quick confirmation.

## What was done at once (2026-09-05T13:2xZ, no protocol text yet)

`needs-user-decision` applied to PR #15856, PR #15641 and objectui PR #7686; a Chinese 「维护者速读」 comment posted on each (改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与代价 / 席位意见 / 你要做的), and on the two decision cards #15453 and #15647.

## What this card writes (the rule, once, in the file that governs the seat)

1. `SKILL.md` 入队与落地 (the governed endgame): at ACCEPT on a governed PR the seat, in the same stroke, (a) adds `needs-user-decision` to the PR and (b) posts a Chinese 「维护者速读」 comment in the fixed five-part shape — what changed in business terms, why, risk and cost (with the rollback), the seat's recommendation, and the one act asked of the maintainer. The English verdict stays the review record; the 速读 is the maintainer's brief. The label leaves with the merge (a closed PR needs no cleanup) or when the seat withdraws the verdict.
2. `SKILL.md` decision-box rule: a `needs-user-decision` card carries the same 速读 shape above its four-facet analysis, so the maintainer reads the options in business terms first.
3. `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: the `needs-user-decision` description gains its PR meaning ("on a PR: awaiting the maintainer's review; a 维护者速读 comment carries the brief") — within the 100-character cap.
4. The language rule: the 速读 is the third Chinese exception on GitHub (with round reports and verbatim maintainer quotes), stated where the language rule lives.
Line-neutral on `SKILL.md` (811/811, headroom 0 — fold, never raise); the patrol row for the half-state (a governed PR with ACCEPT and no label, or a label with no 速读) is a separate card blocked behind #15884, which holds `check-half-states.mjs`.

## Serial

`SKILL.md` and `ensure-pm-labels.sh` are in no flight (PR #15848 and #15795 landed). Governed ⇒ draft PR, in-seat review at contract tier, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge — and, per this very rule, `needs-user-decision` + a 速读 on it.

## Dedup

REST enumeration 2026-09-05T13:20Z, `state=all` sorted by update (1,200 items, 800 issues; positive control #15846 hit): no card proposes a maintainer-facing brief or a list-view label on governed PRs; the `needs-user-decision` hits are the label's existing card meaning.
